@torch.jit.script
def _normalized_gru_layer(projected: torch.Tensor, hidden: torch.Tensor,
                          weight_hh: torch.Tensor, bias_hh: torch.Tensor,
                          norm_weight: torch.Tensor, norm_bias: torch.Tensor):
    outputs: list[torch.Tensor] = []
    width = hidden.size(1)
    for input_gates in projected.unbind(1):
        recurrent = torch.nn.functional.linear(hidden, weight_hh, bias_hh)
        recurrent = recurrent.reshape(-1, 3, width)
        recurrent = torch.nn.functional.layer_norm(recurrent, [width], None, None, 1e-5)
        recurrent = recurrent * norm_weight + norm_bias
        h_reset, h_update, h_new = recurrent.unbind(1)
        i_reset, i_update, i_new = input_gates.chunk(3, dim=-1)
        reset = torch.sigmoid(i_reset + h_reset)
        update = torch.sigmoid(i_update + h_update)
        candidate = torch.tanh(i_new + reset * h_new)
        hidden = candidate + update * (hidden - candidate)
        outputs.append(hidden)
    return torch.stack(outputs, dim=1), hidden


class RecurrentGateNormGRU(nn.GRU):
    def __init__(self, input_size: int, hidden_size: int, num_layers: int = 1,
                 batch_first: bool = True, dropout: float = 0.0):
        super().__init__(input_size, hidden_size, num_layers=num_layers,
                         batch_first=batch_first, dropout=dropout)
        self.recurrent_norm_weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_layers, 3, hidden_size))
        self.recurrent_norm_bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_layers, 3, hidden_size))

    def forward(self, inputs: torch.Tensor, hx: torch.Tensor | None = None):
        out = inputs if self.batch_first else inputs.transpose(0, 1)
        if hx is None:
            hx = out.new_zeros(self.num_layers, out.size(0), self.hidden_size)
        final_states = []
        for layer in range(self.num_layers):
            projected = torch.nn.functional.linear(
                out, getattr(self, f'weight_ih_l{layer}'),
                getattr(self, f'bias_ih_l{layer}')
            )
            out, hidden = _normalized_gru_layer(
                projected, hx[layer], getattr(self, f'weight_hh_l{layer}'),
                getattr(self, f'bias_hh_l{layer}'),
                self.recurrent_norm_weight[layer], self.recurrent_norm_bias[layer]
            )
            final_states.append(hidden)
            if layer + 1 < self.num_layers and self.dropout > 0.0:
                out = torch.nn.functional.dropout(out, p=self.dropout, training=self.training)
        if not self.batch_first:
            out = out.transpose(0, 1)
        return out, torch.stack(final_states, dim=0)
